summary: Chunk 1 (5.1): 39 issues, 8 errors, 31 minor. Main faults: Hindi रसद for rasada (glossary 5.2 says विष देने वाला), hiraṇya as gold (glossary 5.2: money), Hindi 'तीक्ष्ण शस्त्र' reading as a sharp weapon (41,43,45), Hindi सूद for cook, dropped vā/tu in Hindi, 'ऐसा कहकर'/'इस प्रकार' for closing iti. mahā-mātra settled as 'high official(s)' (महामात्र), matching glossary 12.2/5.6. No regrouping suggested; the 38/39 split is as printed. Needs a person: units 9, 20, 37, 55, 21, 31, 33, 47, 52 (obscure terms); merged w in 26 and 32; possible extra text_flags (55 anukṣiyatsu, 39 vā-yaś hyphen, 9 sattri) which patches cannot add.
